exposure: type of surgical procedure (cesarean section, gynecological surgeries, abdominal hysterectomy, vaginal hysterectomy, laparoscopic surgeries)
outcome: types of microbes involved (Klebsiella species, Escherichia coli, Enterococcus, MRSA)
cohort: The study included 528 patients who underwent obstetric or gynecological surgeries at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Postoperative sepsis occurred in 19.8% of cases, being more common in gynecological surgeries, especially open procedures like hysterectomies, with CAUTI identified as the most frequent postoperative infection.
